name: RankMetric – SERP Rank Tracker
author: rankmetricio

sections.description:
RankMetric is a rank tracker and checker built directly into your WordPress dashboard. This is the free version, which allows you to track up to 2 projects. For unlimited projects and keywords, please consider upgrading to RankMetric Pro.

Powered by the robust SerpApi, it allows you to monitor your website’s keyword positions, track competitors, and view detailed reports without ever leaving your site.

Features

  • Accurate Rank Tracking: Get reliable keyword rankings for any country supported by Google.
  • Project Management: Easily add and manage your websites or projects.
  • Competitor Tracking: Add competitor domains to see how you stack up against them.
  • Automated Checks: Set a schedule and let RankMetric check your rankings automatically.
  • Dashboard Widget: See a quick overview of your ranking performance on the main WordPress dashboard.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the rankmetric folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to the RankMetric > Settings page and enter your SERP API key.
  4. Go to RankMetric > Add Project to start tracking your first website!
sections.faq:
Do I need a SERP API account?

Yes, this plugin requires a SERP API account to function. You can get a free account with a monthly search credit at serpapi.com.

How often are the rankings checked?

You can set the check frequency for each project individually. The checks are run automatically by the WordPress cron system.

What is the difference between the free and pro version?

The free version available on WordPress.org is limited to tracking 2 projects. The Pro version allows you to track unlimited projects and keywords.
